title: From Proxies to Fields: Spatiotemporal Reconstruction of Global Radiation from Sparse Sensor Sequences
abstract: arXiv:2506.12045v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate reconstruction of latent environmental fields from sparse, indirect observations is a fundamental challenge across scientific domains, from atmospheric science and geophysics to public health and aerospace safety. Existing approaches typically rely on physics-based simulations or dense sensor networks; however, these methods are hampered by high computational cost, latency, and limited spatial coverage. Here we introduce the \textbf{Temporal Radiation Operator Network (TRON)}, a spatiotemporal neural operator architecture that infers continuous global scalar fields solely from sequences of sparse, non-uniform proxy measurements. Unlike recent prediction models that require dense, gridded inputs to predict system states, TRON tackles sparse-to-dense, cross-domain field reconstruction. translated_title: 从代理数据到场：基于稀疏传感器序列的全球辐射时空重建
translated_abstract: 从大气科学、地球物理到公共卫生和航空航天安全，从稀疏、间接的观测中准确重建潜在环境场是各科学领域面临的一项根本性挑战。现有方法通常依赖于基于物理的模拟或密集的传感器网络；然而，这些方法受到高计算成本、延迟和有限空间覆盖范围的制约。我们在此提出时间辐射算子网络（TRON），这是一种时空神经算子架构，能够仅从稀疏、非均匀的代理测量序列中推断出连续的全球标量场。与近期需要密集网格输入来预测系统状态的预测模型不同，TRON 解决了稀疏到密集的跨域场重建问题。它从稀疏的、随时间演化的传感器数据中实时重建当前的全球场，而无需获取任何未来观测数据。
tldr: 本文提出时间辐射算子网络（TRON），一种时空神经算子架构，能够仅从稀疏、非均匀的代理测量序列中实时重建连续的全球标量场，无需密集网格输入和未来观测数据。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TRON, a spatiotemporal neural operator architecture that reconstructs continuous global scalar fields in real time solely from sparse, non-uniform proxy measurements, without requiring dense gridded inputs or future observations.
